description: Figure 2 is a pie chart that visually represents the composition of the MULTITURNINSTRUCT benchmark dataset. The chart is divided into nine distinct slices, each corresponding to one of the nine capabilities. The slices are colored in various shades of blue, green, and red. The largest slice, colored dark blue, represents the "Static" capability, which accounts for approximately 35% of the total. The "Dynamic" capability, shown in a medium blue, makes up about 25% of the dataset. The "Reasoning" capability, in a lighter blue, is approximately 15%. The "Multitasking" capability, in a green shade, is about 10%. The remaining five capabilities—"Privacy Protection," "Task Planning," "Information Extraction," "Conflict Resolution," and "Contextual Understanding"—are each represented by smaller slices, each accounting for roughly 5% of the dataset. The chart includes a legend on the right side, with each capability name corresponding to its respective color. The percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice, providing a clear breakdown of the balanced distribution of samples across the nine capabilities.
